about: RiverATLAS v1.0 (CC BY 4.0) as built by tools/water/build.py into Water/network.js, lightened by tools/water/build_pack.py. Per stretch: next (index, -1 at an outlet), order (Strahler), km10 (summed reach lengths, tenths of a km), area (km² upstream of its lower end), lines ([lon, lat] in degrees), lod (one digit a vertex: 0 for the ends, else the index+1 of the coarsest of levels it survives at). grid: for each cell of cell degrees, keyed (floor(lon / cell) + 500) * 1000 + floor(lat / cell) + 500, the stretches with a segment there.
